verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms OpenHands publishes an llms.txt at docs.openhands.dev, explicitly described as an "LLM-friendly index" of the V1 documentation, so users can point an agent at it. The SDK guides are also served as raw .md pages, and an OpenAPI spec is exposed. Missing for 10: any first-party guidance on using llms.txt or the markdown docs with agents, evidence of an llms-full.txt or comparable full-content bundle, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: LLM-friendly index of OpenHands documentation (V1). Legacy V0 docs pages are intentionally excluded.
